purpose: A conservative offline inventory that separates normative authority from candidate evidence and binds every runtime category to an explicit claim boundary.

verification.network: The validator checks this committed identity record locally and never fetches the authority URLs.
verification.normative_rule: Only an explicitly listed authority may support a normative claim; candidate sources may suggest examples but cannot establish correctness.
verification.missing_or_extra: Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, or category-unmapped source identities fail closed.

normative_authorities.title: Zasady pisowni i interpunkcji polskiej
normative_authorities.publisher: Rada Języka Polskiego przy Prezydium Polskiej Akademii Nauk
normative_authorities.authority_boundary: Normative for orthography and punctuation only; it does not establish completeness for Polis rule families or normative claims about agreement, inflection, or syntax.

candidate_sources.boundary: The maintained table records closed runtime patterns and scopes; it is not evidence that a category or language phenomenon is complete.

candidate_sources.path: docs/quality-comparison-v3.json and versioned public quality manifests
candidate_sources.boundary: Public v3 artifacts measure the recorded cases and identities; they do not create a normative rule or broaden a capability claim.

category_mappings.claim_boundary: No normative completeness claim is made for agreement; each closed pattern requires its own authority and evidence decision.
No normative completeness claim is made for inflection; morphology and candidate evidence remain bounded and provider-aware.
RJP may establish the correctness of an explicitly mapped punctuation case, not completeness of punctuation coverage.
RJP may establish the correctness of an explicitly mapped spelling case, not completeness of spelling coverage.
No normative completeness claim is made for syntax; punctuation authority is not silently extended to sentence-structure rules.

source_parity.mapping_rule: Every ordered runtime source identity must appear exactly once in the maintained inventory and inherit exactly one category mapping; every category mapping must be used by at least one runtime source.
source_parity.digest_rule: The validator compares the ordered runtime source set and maintained inventory rows independently, then validates the category mapping for every source.
